endpoints.validation: It lies on the OSM 230 kV path west from Adamsville (via way/975245896), beside Boat Rock Rd SW in South Fulton. It is 5.3 mi straight from Adamsville, against the 8.08-mile Adamsville to Boat Rock Road section. The name is inferred from the road.

projects.notes: Work is the 8.08-mile Adamsville to Boat Rock Road section plus jumpers at Bakers Ferry and Boat Rock. Buzzard Roost (title terminal) is locality-only (see gpc:21036), and Bakers Ferry was not identified. IRP p.297 has a GTC companion project: rebuild 5 mi from Buzzard Roost to Boat Rock Road.

endpoints.name: Stonewall Tell Road customer station (TA Realty)
endpoints.coordinateSource: Intersection of OSM 'South Fulton Parkway' and 'Stonewall Tell Road' (Overpass). The site is from ARC DRI 4342 (cached arc-dri-4342-stonewall-tell, p.1): a data center with a proposed electrical substation 'on Stonewall Tell Road south of South Fulton Parkway in the City of South Fulton in Fulton County'.
endpoints.validation: The DRI site plan shows a proposed substation of about 4.25 acres. The link from TA Realty to this DRI comes from secondary news (DCD, which returned 403 when fetched). Another data-center proposal sits in the SE quadrant of the same intersection. The nearest mapped 230 kV lines are 2.3 km away, which is consistent with building a loop-in segment.

projects.notes: The station loops into the East Point - Union City 230kV Black line.
